events.name: DISABLED
events.text: You have a terrible accident which almost cripples you. Your Movement Allowance values should always be read from the line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table. An operation to fix you would cost about 100,000 crowns.

events.name: BONE DISEASE
events.text: Subtract 5 from your maximum HP. An operation to fix you would cost about 50,000 crowns.

events.name: SEVERE CONCUSSION
events.text: You never quite healed from that last blow to your head. Your Defensive and Perception Bonuses should always be read one line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: INVOLVED IN SERIOUS CRIME
events.text: Guilty or not, you've been sentenced to 1d6+3 years of hard labor (adjust your age immediately). Add +3 to STR, CON, and CHA, but subtract 2 from INT and WIS.

events.name: INVOLVED IN MINOR CRIME
events.text: You get involved in some petty organized criminal business and sentenced to 1d3 years (adjust your age immediately) of prison. -2 to STR, CON, and WIS. +2 to CHA.

events.name: GUILTY
events.text: A judge forced you to refund your neighbors for a case against you. Reduce your Credit Score by 5.

events.name: CRIMINAL RECORD
events.text: Your name is mentioned in connection with a criminal act, and you are recorded somewhere in criminal records—probably for the rest of your life. You are automatically unemployed, and you must start your adventuring career immediately. Your Credit Score drops to 1.

events.name: FIRED
events.text: Intrigue and/or mistakes make you lose your job and force you to be unemployed for 1d3 periods of two years each. You may avoid this period of unemployment if you start your adventuring career right away.

events.name: INTENSE EDUCATION
events.text: Narrative flavor — a formative stretch of rigorous study or private schooling that shaped your early worldview.

events.name: PART OF UNEMPLOYMENT PROGRAM
events.text: Should you ever be unemployed, you may automatically choose the Student background instead, even if you do not meet the requirements.

events.name: GOOD NEGOTIATOR
events.text: You excel at leveraging market leverage and managing social friction. Add +2 to CHA.

events.name: GLAMOROUS EMPLOYMENT
events.text: Your presence opens doors in corporate circles. Add +1 to CHA.

events.name: CONTACT WITHIN A MEGACORP
events.text: You have a contact within one of the megacorporations. Work with your GM to decide how this contact provides insider info or favors.

events.name: CIVIL DEFENSE TRAINING
events.text: You have basic civilian defense discipline and weapons handling under stress. Add +1 to DEX.

events.name: TECHNICAL CRASH COURSE
events.text: Intensive technical training gives you a strong grasp of electronics and systems repair. Add +1 to INT.

events.name: ADMINISTRATION NIGHT CLASSES
events.text: Evening coursework improves your procedural knowledge and negotiation discipline. Add +1 to INT.

events.name: GYMNASTICS CLASSES
events.text: Physical conditioning improves your poise, agility, and mobility. Add +1 to DEX.

events.name: EVENING CLASSES
events.text: Broad adult education sharpens your intellect and focus. Add +1 to INT.

events.name: INTERESTING CHARACTER
events.text: You always seem to fascinate people. Add +1 to CHA.

events.name: HARD LABOR
events.text: Manual labor has toughened your body. Add +1 to STR.

events.name: STRONG WILL
events.text: Emotional turmoil and mental distress have hardened your outlook. Add +1 to WIS and +1 to MST.

events.name: HEALTH CARE
events.text: Eating health food and taking care of your body has really paid off. Add +1 to CON.

events.name: AMATEUR GYMNAST
events.text: Add +1 to DEX.

events.name: GOOD IMMUNE SYSTEM
events.text: Your body is extremely resistant to alien organic substances. Add +1 to CON.

events.name: EXTRAORDINARY CHEMICAL TOLERANCE
events.text: Your body is extremely resistant to artificial substances, toxins, and gases. Add +1 to CON.

events.name: GIFTED CHILDHOOD
events.text: Versatile upbringing and early exposure to multiple disciplines. Add +1 to INT and +1 to WIS.

events.name: WEALTHY LOVER
events.text: Your lover is very wealthy, and also quite generous. Add +1 to Credit Score (100 is maximum).

events.name: STEADY EMPLOYMENT
events.text: Gain +1 to any base attribute of your choice.

events.name: AMATEUR ATHLETE
events.text: Add +2 to STR and CON. Your increased characteristics depend upon regular attendance at a gym. Should your Credit Score drop below 4, you must remove these bonuses.

events.name: CHANCE OF A LIFETIME
events.text: You may choose any background, regardless of its requirements and spend 2 years in any profession you like.

events.name: CONTACTS WITHIN POLICE DEPARTMENT
events.text: You will never, ever get your name on a criminal record. If you've been recorded as a criminal, your record is expunged.

events.name: SOLE HEIR TO WEALTHY AUNT
events.text: Your extremely rich aunt remembered you in her will. Add +3 to Credit Score (100 is maximum).

events.name: POWERFUL, FANATIC ENEMY
events.text: Somehow, you manage to get yourself a deadly enemy who unfortunately also happens to be quite powerful. Your enemy might be a district attorney, an old partner, a jealous associate, or whoever—be creative.

events.name: LONG LEGS
events.text: Your Movement Allowance values should always be read from the line below the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: FAMOUS FACE
events.text: You happen to look a lot like a very famous person. Add +5 to CHA.

events.name: MOVIE STAR
events.text: You've had a couple of small parts in soap operas and B-movies. Add +1 to Credit Score and +2 to CHA.

events.name: PROMOTION
events.text: Add +3 to Credit Score and CHA.

events.name: SUBJECT TO EXPERIMENTS
events.text: You volunteer to take part in a secret medical experiment which happens to succeed. Add +5 to WIS.

events.name: COMMANDO TRAINING
events.text: Instead of your next two background periods, you may spend four years in elite commando training (equivalent to attending a Military academy). Add +2 to all base attributes, +5 to CHA, and +2 to Credit Score (100 maximum).
